items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Charlie Sylvester was playing the drum.

ctx.x: Yeah so he would be more famous as a saxophone player then I guess. That's right, he would. The way you say it and everything it looks like. You must have played with somebody else in the 20s, or you say you had some other places, you had your own band.

Yeah, well I played on Bourbon Street in the 30s at 802 for Sam Columbo. It was right across from the paddock. When the paddock was open up, I had been out there playing across the street. Little Sammy Hopkins was on the piano. Charlie, what's his name? Charlie Sylvester was playing the drum. And Chester Lazard was playing the bass. And then later on we got Handy out there. I played there a long time for him. Who's Handy? John Handy, the saxophone player.
Could be other Handys too, you know. There's a many. I'm sorry, I'm sorry.
